references.text: Philip identifies Jesus as 'Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph,' an identity that is central to the doubt expressed in verse 42.
People in Jesus' hometown marvel at his wisdom and powers, asking: 'Isn't this the carpenter's son?', which reflects the doubt about his background in verse 42.
The people of Nazareth know Jesus as 'the carpenter, Mary's son, and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon,' an identity that creates confusion about his divine origin.
